description: This file defines the AWS SSOClient class, a client used to interact with the AWS Single Sign-On service, extending the AwsClient class and including method signatures for various SSO-related operations.

classes.name: SSOClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Single Sign-On service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: getRoleCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves credentials for a specific role in AWS SSO.

methods.name: getRoleCredentialsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves credentials for a specific role in AWS SSO.

methods.name: listAccountRoles
methods.description: Lists the roles available in a specific AWS account.

methods.name: listAccountRolesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists the account roles in AWS SSO.

methods.name: listAccounts
methods.description: Lists AWS accounts accessible via SSO.

methods.name: listAccountsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists AWS accounts via SSO.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out from the AWS SSO session.

methods.name: logoutAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously logs out from the AWS SSO session.
